summary_en: 800,000 shares (2.2% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) up to ¥1.5B aggregate, ceiling price not disclosed, open-market purchase window 13 Jul – 31 Oct 2026. Stated rationale: flexible capital policy in response to changing business environment and shareholder return.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Hi-Lex Corporation's board resolved on 10 July 2026 to acquire up to 800,000 treasury shares under a program authorized by the company's articles of association under the Companies Act. The acquisition is to cost no more than ¥1.5 billion in aggregate. The shares represent 2.2% of shares outstanding (36,991,202 ex-treasury at 30 April 2026). Execution window: 13 July – 31 October 2026, via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. No price ceiling was disclosed. The stated purpose is to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions and to return value to shareholders.
